prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years delivering full-stack platforms, SaaS integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Architected and deployed a React and TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers for high-value subscription accounts. Led modernization from legacy desktop tools to cloud-native web infrastructure, cutting manual data‑processing overhead by 68%. Military logistics experience added disciplined inventory control and process improvement.

bullets.text: Built linkme-intops, a React and TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers, delivering a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that enabled reliable onboarding of enterprise clients to the core platform.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines that cut service delivery times by over 30%.
Constructed automated data-validation pipelines at the database layer, removing 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Led migration from legacy desktop tools to cloud-native web infrastructure, lowering manual data-processing overhead by 68%.
Designed a six-stage agent pipeline that enforced automated verification, preventing hallucinated pricing and claims.
Built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that transforms business URLs into 3D scroll demos in about one minute using Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2, and D1.
Engineered tycodes.dev with edge-deployed Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind on Cloudflare Workers, adding a Hono Worker that runs Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audits and pricing models.
Designed zero-maintenance serverless backends that use Google Sheets via OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers.
Managed over $100 M of federal inventory across 12 sites, achieving 100% audit accuracy and cutting processing times by 35%.
Enforced strict accountability procedures that eliminated supply-chain bottlenecks during high-demand deployments; earned Army Achievement Medal.
